notes: An old bundle waiting in the updater is cleared out the instant the app opens, not four seconds later. The phone-side updater installs whatever is queued by itself every time you leave the app, so an older bundle sitting there was one more chance to be swapped in — and every swap is another restart. The check now runs as soon as the app knows which version it is running

The version the app reports is now the version it is really running. Settings’ version label shipped a placeholder from years ago (“v48”) behind the real one, and an app that had not finished starting could be read as version 48 — which made every version comparison nonsense. The label is stamped by the running build, and the placeholder is gone
